summary: reactive-resume is a self-hosted resume-builder (React/Hono/oRPC/BetterAuth/Drizzle+Postgres/S3) with resume CRUD + versioning + public sharing/statistics, a job-application tracker with a stage/timeline state machine, an in-app AI agent (threads/messages/patched resume actions + AI provider credentials), user auth/2FA/passkeys/API-keys/oauth, and object storage for uploaded files.
